action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

sound_fx_segments.label: SOUND FX
sound_fx_segments.text: Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.
